title: A model for investment type recommender system based on the potential investors based on investors and experts feedback using ANFIS and MNN
authors: Asemi, A.; Asemi, A.; Ko, A.
tldr: An ANFIS-based investment recommender system using multimodal neural network pretraining and expert feedback predicts suitable investment types from clustered investor profiles with moderate accuracy.
problem_and_motivation: Individual investors struggle to make informed decisions in complex financial markets due to market volatility, changing economic conditions, and data overload. There is a gap in systems that predict investment types based on a combination of demographic, personality, financial, and managerial traits simultaneously.
approach: Collected data from 1542 respondents via a web-based questionnaire covering demographics, financial status, experiences, personality, managerial traits, key decision factors, and investment preferences.
Preprocessed and clustered data using ETL tools, JMP, MATLAB, and Python, applying K-Means clustering with Elbow Curve and Silhouette score validation to reduce to 188 investor groups.
Designed a Sugeno-type ANFIS model with three clustered inputs and one output representing investment type preference, using trimf membership functions and constant output MFs.
Trained the ANFIS model using a hybrid approach over three epochs with 188 data pairs and 18 fuzzy rules, achieving a training RMSE of 0.721054.
Applied multimodal neural network pretraining using Keras to initialize ANFIS weights, achieving a test MSE of 0.001199 on preprocessed data.
Evaluated system performance using RMSE, accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics.
Incorporated expert feedback and investor opinions to refine fuzzy rules and customize investment recommendations.
Compared results against traditional methods including decision trees and logistic regression to demonstrate ANFIS superiority.
findings: num: F1-score of 0.6667 achieved by the ANFIS model across 18 fuzzy rules.
num: Minimal training RMSE of 0.721054 obtained using a hybrid training approach over three epochs with 188 data pairs.
num: Test MSE of 0.001199 achieved after multimodal neural network pretraining.
num: 188 potential investor groups derived from 1542 original respondents after K-Means clustering and frequency filtering.
The system outperformed traditional methods including decision trees and logistic regression for investment type prediction.
num: Three ANFIS inputs (financial information, investment experiences, personality-managerial traits) were sufficient to predict investment type output.

topic_relevance.contribution_to_field: This paper contributes a hybrid investment recommender system architecture combining ANFIS fuzzy inference with multimodal neural network pretraining for personalized investment type prediction.
directly_justifies: ANFIS-based recommender system using multimodal neural network pretraining achieves moderate accuracy for investment type prediction.
Hybrid training over three epochs with 188 data pairs yields an F1-score of 0.6667 and training RMSE of 0.721054.
Multimodal pretraining with Keras initializes ANFIS weights effectively, reducing test MSE to 0.001199.
Expert feedback integration enables continuous refinement of fuzzy rules and recommendation customization.
limits: Dataset reduced to 188 investor groups from 1542 respondents, limiting generalizability.
Training converged quickly at approximately 0.72 RMSE per epoch without further optimization.
System designed for retail investors only, explicitly acknowledged as unsuitable for institutional investors.
Potential biases from historical data usage not examined.
topic_relevance.topic_mapping_rationale: All fourteen topic domains were systematically scanned. Domains 4.A, 4.B, 6.A, and 14.B were flagged as high or medium relevance. Domain 5.A was included at medium relevance for investor clustering by demographic and personality traits. Domain 12.A was included at medium relevance due to evaluation using RMSE, F1-score, and comparison with baseline methods.

remember_this: ANFIS-based investment recommender system combines fuzzy logic with neural network pretraining for personalized recommendations.
The model achieved an F1-score of 0.6667 and training RMSE of 0.721054 using 188 data pairs and 18 fuzzy rules.
Multimodal neural network pretraining reduced test MSE to 0.001199, improving model convergence.
Expert feedback integration enables continuous rule refinement, enhancing recommendation accuracy.
System outperformed traditional methods including decision trees and logistic regression for investment type prediction.
